turns.doctor_question: Can you describe how you were feeling in the days or weeks leading up to that decision at work? Were you feeling unusually energetic, confident, or excited?
turns.patient_response:
Yeah, I definitely was. For the past few weeks leading up to it, I felt... well, brilliantly alive. Like I was finally going to show leadership what HR can really be. I had all this energy and confidence. 

But it wasn't just excitement. I also noticed I would get suddenly furious if anyone questioned me. Even over really small things, you know? Like if someone brought up minor edits to a document or just asked routine budget questions, I would just snap. So it was this mix of feeling completely unstoppable, but then getting incredibly angry if anyone pushed back or got in my way.
